english.title: Fail to comply with summons to give evidence / produce document at an inquiry - transport safety
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a summons issued under section 60 of the Railways and Transport Safety Act 2003 to attend an inquiry into a matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATTER..), connected with the British Transport Police force and

(A)_[give evidence]_
(B)_[produce a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..)]_
(C)_[give evidence and produce a document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DOCUMENT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(3)(a) and (5) of the Railways and Transport Safety Act 2003.
